content.title: Reno Park Addition Historic District
content.summary: The Reno Park Addition Historic District is located between Yukon and Yarrow Streets to the east, Allison and Zephyr Streets to the west, Ralston Road to the north, and Ridge Road to the south. It features primarily single-family homes, some of which serve as offices or light commercial spaces, with most structures dating back to the 1800s. Any modifications or redevelopment in the area may require a Certificate of Compliance in accordance with the Reno Park Addition Design Guidelines.
content.body:
The Reno Park Addition Historic District encompasses a specified area that is generally defined as the alley between Yukon and Yarrow Street to the east, the alley between Allison and Zephyr Street to the west, and Ralston Road to the north, and Ridge Road to the south. Buildings within Reno Park are single-family homes with some being used as offices and other light-commercial uses. Most of the buildings in Reno Park were built in the 1800s and resemble key features from this era. Modifications, additions, restorations, or redevelopment in Reno Park MAY require a [Certificate of Compliance](/180/Olde-Town-Reno-Park-Design-Guidelines) with the Reno Park Addition Design Guidelines prior to construction.
